paper.title_en: Area-Information Trade-Offs in Acceleration Radiation from Atoms Falling into Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: We develop a geometric theory of information processing in the Horizon-brightened acceleration radiation (HBAR) channel, in which the radiative horizon-area change provides an entropy budget for the information carried by the radiation field. Building on the quantum-optical description of atom--field interactions near the horizon and the resulting HBAR thermodynamic correspondence, we derive area-cost laws in the near-steady, thermally saturated regime. The accessible classical information and the mutual information generated between the radiation field and its environment are bounded by the associated radiative horizon-area budget. Reliability is incorporated through Fano's inequality, which translates a prescribed decoding error probability into an area requirement. We further derive Fisher-information speed limits that constrain the statistical evolution of the radiation field and place a lower bound on the duration required for correlation generation. Together, these results establish a bits-per-area principle linking black-hole thermodynamics, information geometry, and quantum information in the HBAR framework.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在黑洞热力学和量子信息理论之间建立了新的联系，提出了一个几何信息处理框架，并推导出面积-成本定律和Fisher信息速度极限，具有理论深度和原创性。尽管是预印本且无引用，但论文内容新颖且方法严谨，值得读者关注。
decision.title_zh: 落入黑洞的原子的加速辐射中的面积-信息权衡
decision.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一种关于地平线增亮加速辐射（HBAR）信道中信息处理的几何理论，在该信道中，辐射的地平线面积变化为辐射场所携带的信息提供了熵预算。基于原子-场与地平线相互作用的量子光学描述以及由此产生的HBAR热力学对应关系，我们在近稳态、热饱和状态下推导出面积-成本定律。可访问的经典信息和辐射场与其环境之间产生的互信息受到相关辐射地平线面积预算的限制。可靠性通过Fano不等式纳入，该不等式将指定的解码错误概率转化为面积要求。我们进一步推导了Fisher信息速度极限，该极限约束辐射场的统计演化，并对相关性生成所需的持续时间设置了下限。总之，这些结果在HBAR框架中确立了一个连接黑洞热力学、信息几何和量子信息的每比特面积原理。
